csv_project_name: Design for Flora Park Tennis Courts Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Dubuque, Iowa is soliciting competitive sealed qualifications from professional consulting firms to provide construction drawings, specifications, and bidding documents to renovate five(5) tennis courts at Flora Park, 2605 Pennsylvania Avenue, Dubuque, Iowa. The City seeks qualified professional consultants to provide design and construction management services for the Flora Park Tennis Courts Improvement Project. The selected consultant will be expected to provide a range of services that may include, but are not limited to, the following: 1. Topographic Survey 2. Engineering and Design 3. Construction Services
